Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, is seated in a wheelchair. He is surrounded by his family and friends, all beaming with pride.

GEORGE
(through gritted teeth)
I Don't Understand Why I'm Here

The officials begin to present George with a certificate and a trophy. The room erupts in applause as George's face lights up with a mix of emotions.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, surrounded by photos and mementos from his long life. He gazes up at the ceiling, lost in thought. Suddenly, his eyes land on a small piece of paper on his nightstand. It's an old article he read on the internet years ago.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality...

As he reads the article, a look of confusion and unease creeps onto his face. He begins to pace around the room, his eyes darting back and forth.

GEORGE
( muttering to himself)
If I'm Immortal... Then What Does That Mean?

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S MIND - NIGHT

George's mind begins to unravel as he delves deeper into the concept of Quantum Immortality. He sees himself as a tiny particle, bouncing between parallel universes, living an infinite number of lives.

GEORGE
(voice rising)
I'M LIVING IN A SIMULATION! I'M A PARTICLE IN A MULTIVERSE!

The room around him begins to distort and blur. George's face contorts in a mixture of fear and excitement.

GEORGE
( screaming at the top of his lungs)
I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO KNOWS THE TRUTH! I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S REALLY ALIVE!

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George collapses onto his bed, his body shaking with sobs. His mind is consumed by the weight of his own immortality. The camera zooms out as George's body begins to fade away, his consciousness lost in the vast expanse of the multiverse.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
